scope: Independent read-only source review and local SHA verification of supplied CPU evidence. No code edits, duplicate tests, model load or NPU execution.

cpu_evidence.scope: Real Torch CPU arithmetic with tiny 50-block/200-linear/400-adapter model and pinned official sampler AST. No real H3/VAE weights loaded, no Comfy device imports, no NPU call, no training dataset, no production checkpoint or launch configuration. Actual arrays and safetensors are exercised in temporary test fixtures; this is not real-model numerical acceptance.
cpu_evidence.fixture_IO: Only full 400-adapter CPU test batches partial.json metadata; every actual NPY/safetensors/array hash is still written and checked. Small tests use production atomic partial writes. Production code save behavior is unchanged.

resolved_findings.issue: Whole pretrained record comparison included process-dependent load times and precision_initial.
resolved_findings.resolution: stable_pretrained explicitly compares stable recipe/runtime fields; active math and frozen fingerprints are independently checked.

resolved_findings.issue: Adapter provenance helpers require the pretrained fingerprint record, rather than the complete H3 diagnostic record.
FP64 observation statistics on NPU had an unverified device-compatibility risk.
resolved_findings.resolution: Norm/RMS observations use detach().cpu().double(); actual SGD/addmm/cast remain device FP32/BF16. No actual NPU FP64 failure is asserted.

resolved_findings.issue: A merged resident session otherwise inherited misleading independent-adapter arithmetic and vacuous empty B-zero claims.
resolved_findings.resolution: Merged mode reports merged BF16 weights, zero live adapter tensors and B_zero not applicable.

resolved_findings.issue: Nonfinite observation statistics could prevent writing failure evidence under allow_nan=False.
resolved_findings.resolution: finite_stat records null for nonfinite statistics; final CPU negative test verifies nonfinite merge evidence before any base write.

checked_protocol: Actual 50-block target module inventory derives exact 400 FP32 adapter tensor shapes from 200 linears, rejects aliases and unintended trainables, and verifies finite values before strict save/reload.
A single ordinary SGD update uses lr=1e-4, no momentum/weight decay, one division by loss scale 1024, and saved actual gradients; no adaptive optimizer, tuning or automatic extra step is introduced.
Complete three-step video/audio trajectories use the fixed raw warm start, guide and seed. Only zero-adapter trajectory has a same-graph RGB backward; updated/reloaded/merged passes are no-grad.
The prior accepted joint report/audit/archive and input arrays are SHA-bound. Zero-adapter video/audio parity is strict; decoded RGB uses the existing VAE tolerances and also records bit equality.

The saved 400-tensor adapter is verified before destructive clearing of all A/B tensors. Reloaded live tensors and updated-versus-reloaded video/audio/RGB must be exactly equal in the same unmerged mode.

Merge occurs outside the previous resident session; each intended FP32 addmm then BF16 cast is checked against the actual existing runtime merge. Only 200 named base weight writes are allowed; all other base parameters and registered buffers remain checked.
Merged-versus-unmerged endpoint differences and BF16 rounding are descriptive, not an equivalence gate. Tiny rounded-to-zero updates do not trigger an increased learning rate or additional step.

Per-forward/per-recompute decoder math contexts, model/patcher restoration, checkpoints, finite gradients and frozen inventories are checked. Native VAE tiling remains; encode and fallback paths are forbidden.
Actual budgets are recorded and gated: 12 explicit NFE, 4 decode calls, 1 RGB backward, 1 SGD step, 1 checkpoint save, 1 clear/reload and 1 merge. Checkpoint recomputation is counted separately.
acceptance_boundaries: Final CPU evidence covers real Torch arithmetic on a tiny model and official sampler AST; it is not actual H3/VAE numerical, memory, runtime or NPU acceptance.
The complete fixture batches partial JSON metadata only; actual arrays/safetensors/hash operations remain exercised. Production partial-output cost is not estimated from the 6.767-second test run.
Synthetic SGD is an engineering update/reload diagnostic, not restoration training or Adam stability evidence. The saved adapter is explicitly diagnostic.
The prior strict VAE gradient-repeatability failure remains failed. Small joint success does not validate full 22-frame joint memory, nonzero deployment semantics or restoration quality.
Any actual-model run still requires separately frozen runtime, exact dependency/asset pins, fresh resource admission and bounded execution. This source review does not launch or authorize a run.
